body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported CAMCraft’s two-punch job. The control resolved both threading points and plotted 16 cutting blocks with a 1 mm separation for each punch. The traces showed no cutting transit between the punches. See #2999 for the per-work technology check.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port: this branch is now on the zero-step setup writer of #2984, stacked on #2972 (`f99a9d736`). New head: `04cec49fe`. The merge resolved five conflicts. In each, the frame version was kept and the group behaviour was added again by hand. The old script writer `jescript.rs` stays deleted. Each work now refers to the one `CCB030` quality of the piece. The old per-work names `QN2` and `QN3` are removed. The emulated control imported `PAIR20` with zero steps on each work. It gave `CCB030[4]` on each work after TECCUT and "geen fouten" after the formal check. The plot has the same 16 cut blocks as the original run. The PR body has the readings.

Needs changes before merge.

This is the first review of this head. I read the complete diff against current upstream main.
The safety review ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2974`.
The trial merge is `c90a2d1f85ac6cb89cc29ec2a714ae1cf3f8b847`, with main `ed873f34404ce9496178f4e1e31bbe1fa2d9bfb2`.
Its first parent is the PR head above. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: Add before/after screenshots of the new Passes controls to this PR body. The body has no UI screenshots. Store the images only on your fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit the images to this branch.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to this PR body. This changed skill is a process file. Current main requires this line. Leave `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` to the merging session.
3. `crates/post/tests/agie_group_setup.rs:1` and `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`: Give the required reason for each new top-level test binary in this PR body. Alternatively, move these tests into an existing domain directory suite. Current main's “New tests join a directory suite” rule requires this reason. The test list does not explain why separate binaries are needed.

What looks good:

- Each group work has its own modeled punch, ISO resource and threading point. Unowned and repeated model sources are refused.
- The clear-band check includes the retained solid, threading path, lead, rough miter and wire radius before publication.
- I checked every line of the added `PAIR20.SBL`, `PAIR20.SBR` and `LOWER20.SBL` goldens. The work fields agree with the shared writer and the reported control readings. The closed single-work goldens retain their bytes.

Build and tests, all local:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 527 steps passed, zero failures and zero stalls. Wall time: 46.6 minutes.
- Library tests: post 128 passed; app 305 passed; UI 1,586 passed and eight ignored. The new UI Apply/undo test passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: six steps passed, zero failures and zero stalls. All 11 selected tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick run passed `flute_reach`, `pocket3d_hsm` and `rotary_verify` on this main. There was no failed step to compare on bare main.

Input mutations, rerun by this review:

- `group::a_shared_source_an_unowned_model_or_a_crossing_thread_path_writes_nothing`: passed. All five changed inputs were refused. These inputs use a repeated source, an unowned third model, two unsafe threading positions, or a missing capture declaration.
- `cutoff::unsafe_or_unconfirmed_cutoffs_publish_no_files`: passed. All six changed inputs were refused. These inputs remove a clamp declaration, clear the travel declaration, reverse the kerf side, state a drilled hole, increase clearance, or break the stock span.
- Each rejected export returned an error and left no job directory: the expected red result. The corresponding valid pair and both valid cutoffs passed: green controls.
- The post library also passed `the_band_between_punches_includes_the_rough_corner_lead_and_wire`, including its accepted and refused layouts.

These are input mutations from the PR tests. I did not edit source code for mutation testing.
